adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, both `update` and `destroy` fetch the record with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first`, which returns `nil` when the id does not exist. `update` then calls `save_host(host)` and `save_host` immediately does `host.host = ...`, and `destroy` does `host.destroy`; both will raise `NoMethodError` on `nil`, yielding a 500 instead of a not-found response. This is directly verifiable from the diff.
